answer: Admission runs through one narrow inlet where a newcomer enters only when an established sponsor stakes 30 POA behind them. Reputation grows slowly, like a willow in a shared garden of real work — each job adds growth, each idle epoch trims it 5%. Faking work slashes the sponsor's stake and removes both. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 30,000 POA locked, more than those shells could ever earn. An honest agent pays once and earns in a market not diluted by fakes.
